from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_login_successful(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/liberty/auth/login')
    page.fill('#username', '{{username}}')
    page.fill('#password', '{{password}}')
    page.click('button:has-text("Login")')
    expect(page).to_have_url('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/liberty/pages/home')
    expect(page.locator('div.p-toast-detail')).to_contain_text('Login Successful')
